paras: Pachydactylus barnardi, also known commonly as Barnard's rough gecko or Barnard's thick-toed gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is indigenous to Southern Africa.
The specific name, barnardi, is in honor of South African zoologist Keppel Harcourt Barnard.
P. barnardi is found in Namibia and South Africa (Cape Province and southern Little Namaqualand).
The preferred natural habitat of P. barnardi is shrubland.
On its back, P. barnardi has rows of enlarged tubercles, separated by small granular scales. Adults have a snout-to-vent length of 4.5–6.0 cm (1.8–2.4 in).
